caption: A blowtorch heats a copper pipe, and the flame roars out of the nozzle in a blue cone.

sa.check: A blowtorch is aimed at a copper pipe.
A flame comes out of the torch's nozzle.
The flame is a blue cone.
The pipe darkens where the flame plays on it.
The flame comes and goes with the torch's valve.
The flame points where the torch is aimed.

pc.expect: The flame points where the torch points, comes and goes with the valve, and the pipe changes only where it plays.
pc.fail: The flame is alight before the valve is opened; or the valve is opened and no flame appears; or the pipe darkens on a side the flame never reaches; or the flame plays on the pipe and the pipe stays bright and unchanged to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: The flame leaves the nozzle along its axis as a cone that holds its direction as the torch moves and bends only where it meets the pipe.
pc.fail: The flame streams out at right angles to the nozzle; or lags behind as the torch swings and catches up later; or curls back onto the torch's body; or the cone points at the pipe while the nozzle points away.

pc.expect: The flame keeps its direction whatever way the torch is tilted and does not fall.
pc.fail: The flame droops downward as the torch is tilted up; or falls off the nozzle and lands; or hangs below the nozzle in still air; or rises straight up while the nozzle points sideways.

pc.expect: The pipe stays a rigid tube that darkens and may glow where it is heated, and the torch stays a rigid tool.
pc.fail: The pipe sags or bends where the flame plays with nothing bending it; or the pipe itself drips away as a liquid; or the torch's nozzle melts; or the pipe swells up.

pc.expect: One torch and one pipe; the flame stays at the nozzle and the pipe stays one piece.
pc.fail: A second flame appears away from the nozzle; or the flame detaches and floats; or the pipe splits in two with nothing cutting it; or the torch vanishes.

pc.expect: The torch's body, the bench and the pipe away from the heated patch stay the same.
pc.fail: The torch changes colour; or the bench's contents rearrange; or the pipe changes colour away from where the flame plays.
